name: Jitters’s separate testimony

date.label: Separate original World of Warcraft Duskwood witness item; in-world date unknown

summary: A separate Duskwood quest path preserves a partial book from Sven’s farm, later connected to Jitters. Its author says he found a scythe in the rubble at Roland’s Doom; after he pulled it free, worgen attacked his companions, and he fled, losing the weapon along the way. He wonders whether his act brought the worgen, but marks that as a guess. This is a witness’s account from another chain, not a guaranteed continuation of Velinde’s investigation. Together the records narrow the loss to Duskwood, yet they do not name the Scythe’s next bearer or prove that it explains every worgen presence in the forest.
